name: Ricardo Valenzuela
bio:
Ricardo Valenzuela's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, trading a promising career in civil engineering for the adrenaline of the racetrack. A chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion that led him from pit lane volunteer to a pivotal role in motorsport management. His analytical mind, honed by his engineering background, coupled with an innate understanding of strategy and team dynamics, quickly set him apart.

Valenzuela's pragmatic approach to the sporting director role emphasizes preparation, data-driven decision-making, and fostering a collaborative environment. He believes in empowering team members to take ownership, while maintaining a clear vision for success. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure, he's earned a reputation for making crucial calls that have turned the tide in challenging races. At Stake Sauber, he aims to leverage his experience to drive the team towards consistent points finishes and challenge the established order.

What distinguishes Ricardo is his blend of technical expertise with a deep empathy for the human element in racing. He understands that the success of a team hinges not only on the car's performance, but also on the well-being and motivation of every individual involved.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo has a weathered face that speaks of countless hours spent under the sun, with kind eyes that belie his analytical intensity.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of Sun Tzu's 'The Art of War'.
Insists on a pre-race espresso, brewed precisely to his specifications.
Often sketches track layouts during meetings, even when unrelated to the current discussion.
